name: Dr. Meera Nambiar
title: Chief Aesthetic Dermatologist & MD
qualifications: MD Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy (AIIMS New Delhi), Fellow in Aesthetic Laser Medicine (Singapore)
bio: Dr. Meera Nambiar is an internationally acclaimed cosmetic dermatologist with over 14 years of clinical mastery. She leads Celebs Alley's clinical AI calibration board and specializes in recalcitrant melasma, post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, and sub-dermal barrier restoration.

testimonials.author: Ananya Singhania
testimonials.comment: Dr. Meera decoded my hormonal pigmentation like no one else before. The AI scan plus her 30-day regimen cleared my dark spots completely.

testimonials.author: Priya Varma
testimonials.comment: Incredible attention to detail. She adjusted my retinal strength perfectly without any flaking or irritation.

name: Dr. Aditya Singhal
title: Laser & Anti-Aging Specialist, MBBS, DDVL
qualifications: MBBS (KMC Manipal), DDVL (CMC Vellore), Board Certified in Laser Dermatology
bio: With 11 years of surgical and procedural dermatology expertise, Dr. Aditya is renowned for non-ablative laser resurfacing, RF microneedling, and cellular collagen induction for scarring and texture refinement.

testimonials.author: Rohan Kapur
testimonials.comment: Dr. Aditya's RF microneedling protocol smoothed out deep acne scars I had struggled with for a decade. Super professional.

name: Dr. Shalini Deshmukh
title: Ayurvedic Cosmetologist & Formulator, MD (Ayu)
qualifications: BAMS (Pune), MD Dravyaguna (Vaidya Academy Jaipur), Diploma in Cosmetic Chemistry
bio: Dr. Shalini merges classical Ayurvedic toxicology-free botany with modern dermatological bio-conductors. She formulates Celebs Alley's proprietary 24K Swarna Bhasma and Kashmiri Saffron preparations.

testimonials.author: Devika Rathore
testimonials.comment: The Kanza glow facial ritual and saffron oil routine prescribed by Dr. Shalini gave me the exact glass skin bridal glow I dreamed of.

name: Dr. Sneha Iyer
title: Clinical Photobiologist & Cosmetologist, MD
bio: Specialist in light-based therapeutics, rosacea management, and environmental UV/pollution barrier defense mechanisms with 9 years of clinical research experience.

testimonials.author: Gauri Sharma
testimonials.comment: My extreme rosacea flushing reduced dramatically after Dr. Sneha's soothing phototherapy regimen.

name: Dr. Radhika Sen
title: Chief Pediatric & Barrier Dermatologist, DDV
qualifications: MBBS, DDV (Grant Medical College, Mumbai), Fellow in Atopic Dermatitis (Munich)
bio: Pioneering cellular lipids researcher focusing on atopic eczema, lipid depletion, and microbiome balancing in high-pollution metropolises.

testimonials.author: Kavita Reddy
testimonials.comment: Restored my daughter's compromised skin barrier in 3 weeks with her gentle lipid emulsion.

name: Dr. Farhan Alvi
title: Dermato-Surgeon & Trichology Specialist, MD
qualifications: MD Dermatology (Osmania), Advanced Fellowship in Procedural Cosmetology (Milan)
bio: Specializing in procedural chemical peels, sebaceous hyperplasia clearance, and micro-needling collagen synthesis for texture renewal.

testimonials.author: Zeeshan Khan
testimonials.comment: The TCA cross procedure cleared my ice-pick scarring with zero downtime. Outstanding precision.
